summary: Establishes the workflow repository foundations with curated examples, clear repository boundaries, and a built-in official reserve-workflows descriptor.
highlights: Adds four curated educational workflow examples and documentation
Defines the distinction between examples, local workflows, reserve-workflows, and future private repositories
Adds the internal official repository descriptor for reserve-workflows and its RESERVE API boundary
Documents the intentionally small future workflow distribution API without adding remote commands
Updates the supported release toolchain note to Go 1.27.1
update_instructions: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page or rerun the install script from download.reservecli.dev.
